record.question: Which one of the following statements about Arbitrator is inaccurate?
options: Arbitration clause can be invoked by Engineer-in-Charge or contractor by applying to the Arbitrator Appointing Authority to appoint Arbitrator at any point during the execution of works.
Existence of dispute is not necessarily a condition precedent to arbitration and subsequent appointment of Arbitrator.
The mandate of an appointed arbitrator is not revocable except with the order of the court or his resignation or by consent of both the parties.
The award by the Arbitrator is final and binding on all parties to the contract, unless it is set aside by Court of Law, or a stay obtained by a separate application on the award from the court.
record.explanation: Existence of a dispute is a condition precedent to arbitration.
